name: John Tyler
bioAdditions: Tenth U.S. President; second husband of John's cousin Julia Gardiner (married 26 Jun 1844 per Wikipedia; Gardiner 1890 gives 20 June 1844). In-law only.

conflicts.foundValue: 20 June 1844 (Gardiner 1890 p. 149) vs 26 June 1844 (Wikipedia, Julia Gardiner Tyler)
conflicts.assessment: Wikipedia's 26 June 1844 is the commonly cited date; Gardiner's '20' may be a misprint.

sources.citation: Curtiss C. Gardiner, Lion Gardiner and his Descendants (1890) (archive.org full text), p. 149
sources.supports: Juliana m. 20 June 1844 John Tyler; children listed

sources.citation: Wikipedia, 'Julia Gardiner Tyler' (intro via MediaWiki API)
